PM Modi and President Zelenskyy discuss Russia-Ukraine peace efforts

articles.headline: Delhi AQI Plummets Following Diwali Fireworks
articles.brief: Delhi's air quality dropped sharply as revellers defied bans to mark Diwali with illegal fireworks, pushing North India's pollution levels into the severe zone and triggering emergency restrictions.

articles.headline: Disney and Adobe Partner for Custom AI Models
articles.brief: Entertainment giant Disney and software maker Adobe have announced a partnership to co-develop custom artificial intelligence models tailored specifically for media production and creative workflows.

articles.headline: AI Boom Drives Scramble for Aged Gas Turbines
articles.brief: The massive power requirements of expanding artificial intelligence data centres have sparked an unusual global rush to acquire second-hand gas turbines and jet engines to avoid power shortages.

articles.headline: Gold Rises as Lower Oil Prices Ease Inflation Fears
articles.brief: Gold prices gained traction in global markets as declining crude oil prices helped alleviate broader investor anxieties regarding persistent inflation and macroeconomic pressures.

articles.headline: Nvidia Stocks Drop Amid Independent Probe into CEO
articles.brief: Nvidia shares plunged following news that an independent committee of directors launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang regarding alleged compliance and personal conduct concerns.

articles.headline: South African Voters Rebuff ANC in Election Shift
articles.brief: South African voters decisively rejected the long-ruling African National Congress, accelerating a structural shift toward multi-party coalition politics across the country.

articles.headline: Cardiologists Urge Review of Single-Use Device Ban
articles.brief: Medical specialists have requested a policy review regarding the ban on reusing single-use cardiac devices, arguing that regulated reuse could significantly reduce angioplasty treatment costs.

articles.headline: Goa Beach Ranks Sixth Globally in Beach Index
articles.brief: Palolem Beach in South Goa has achieved international acclaim, securing the top spot in Asia and ranking sixth worldwide in the latest global beach index rankings.

articles.headline: UAE Linked to Colombian Mercenaries in Sudan War
articles.brief: A United Nations report has revealed that the United Arab Emirates helped finance and train Colombian mercenaries deployed to support paramilitary forces involved in the Sudanese conflict.

articles.headline: Smriti Mandhana to Captain India Across Formats
articles.brief: Star batter Smriti Mandhana has been named captain of the Indian women's cricket team across all three formats ahead of their upcoming tour of South Africa in December.

articles.headline: PM Modi Discusses Ukraine Peace with Zelenskyy
articles.brief: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a diplomatic conversation with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, discussing ongoing international efforts to achieve a peaceful resolution.

articles.headline: Russell Brand Sentenced to Prison for Rape
articles.brief: British comedian and actor Russell Brand has been sentenced to ten and a half years in prison after being convicted on multiple counts of rape and sexual assault.

articles.headline: National Health Authority Plans Model Digital Hospitals
articles.brief: The National Health Authority is spearheading an initiative to build model digitalized hospitals across districts, introducing QR-based registration and unified electronic health records.

articles.headline: Britannia CEO Questions Reliance Biscuit Strategy
articles.brief: Britannia Industries chief executive officer has expressed skepticism over Reliance's ability to easily disrupt the domestic biscuit market in the same manner as previous consumer ventures.

articles.headline: Athletes Elected in IOA Sportspersons Polls
articles.brief: Eminent sportsperson representatives including Saina Nehwal and Anju Bobby George were successfully elected in the six-way Indian Olympic Association merit elections.

articles.headline: Indian Rupee Snaps Winning Streak on Dollar Bids
articles.brief: The Indian rupee halted its six-day winning streak following sustained dollar demand from state-run banks amid shifting foreign exchange market conditions.
